title.narrative: Strengthening Regional Energy Governance in the Pacific: Establishing of a Pacific Regional Energy Commissioner

description.narrative: To accelerate the just and equitable energy transition and sustainable development of Pacific Island Countries and Territories’ (PICTs), with a focus on ODA-eligible Pacific Small Island Developing States (PSIDS). This will be achieved through a phased approach that first establishes a Pacific Regional Energy Auditor within SPC to provide independent verification and reporting, followed by the establishment of a Pacific Regional Energy Commissioner (REC) within PIFS to lead high-level advocacy, coordination, and strategic leadership. This initiative aims to advance a fossil fuel-free Pacific, where all countries are on a clear trajectory to energy independence and reaching their decarbonisation ambitions by 2050.
